title: Divergence: parse_block tail-promotion encodes value-less trailing if/else as Expr::If (corpus binary_search.loop#1)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Failing test at thermite-syntax/tests/divergence_final.rs::divergence_value_less_trailing_if_is_statement_not_tail_expr demonstrates the divergence.

Authority: .design/syntax/surface-grammar.md decision #2 ('the expression form ... must have a value; the statement form does not') + OQ-3 ('the corpus only uses the statement form'). Discriminator is value-ness, not source position.

Corpus conformance/binary_search.th ends its loop body with 'if haystack[mid] < needle { lo = mid + 1; } else { hi = mid; }' — both branches are assignment statements (Block tail: None), producing no value, so by the design this is the STATEMENT form. The #30 if-tail refactor (parse_block + parse_if_parts) promotes it to a tail Expr::If purely because it has an else and nothing follows. Result: lp.body.tail = Some(Expr::If{..}) on a value-less construct.

Masked because conformance/parse/binary_search.facts.json is representation-agnostic and pins no stmt-vs-tail fact. Root cause: tail-promotion in parse_block must additionally require that at least one branch produces a value (tail.is_some()) before hoisting to Expr::If; otherwise it is Stmt::If.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: PLAN: commit the failing pinned test thermite-syntax/tests/divergence_final.rs to main (un-#[ignore]d, the failing test IS the block per goal.md R-DEFER-3). Critic does not fix; the fixer must add a value-ness condition (tail.is_some() in at least one branch) to the parse_block tail-promotion before hoisting if/else to Expr::If, otherwise emit Stmt::If.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
FIXED in parse_block (thermite-syntax/src/parser.rs). The trailing-if/else -> tail Expr::If promotion is now gated on VALUE-NESS, not position: condition changed from 'if self.check(&TokKind::RBrace)' to 'if self.check(&TokKind::RBrace) && then.tail.is_some()'. A value-less trailing if/else (both branches statement-only, e.g. corpus binary_search.loop#1 'if .. { lo = mid + 1; } else { hi = mid; }') now falls through to the existing Stmt::If arm, leaving the loop body tail: None.

Authority: .design/syntax/surface-grammar.md decision #2 + OQ-3 (discriminator is value-ness). Value-ness signal = then-branch block tail.is_some() (branch type-agreement is a downstream/forge concern).
